name: x4codesense
description: Language support for X4: Foundations scripts (AI scripts and Mission Director scripts): completion, hover, navigation and diagnostics, powered by a language server.

x4CodeSense.unpackedFileLocation.description: Path to the extracted vanilla game files (the folder holding aiscripts, md, libraries and t).

x4CodeSense.extensionsFolder.description: Path to a folder with other extensions whose scripts and texts should be visible.

x4CodeSense.languageNumber.description: Preferred language number for text lookups, for example 44 for English.

x4CodeSense.limitLanguageOutput.description: Show only the preferred language in text hovers.

x4CodeSense.validateXmlStructure.description: Check the order and completeness of child elements against the game's XSD schemas. Unknown elements and attributes and invalid attribute values are always reported when the unpacked game files are configured.

x4CodeSense.debug.description: Verbose language server logging in the X4CodeSense output channel.

x4CodeSense.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the X4CodeSense language server.
